description: Stage 1 accepts an intent that states no assumptions, so an inferred requirement can be wrong or untested without anyone seeing it; the biggest failures come from untested assumptions.
goal: Make Stage 1 intent validation (flow/intent_questions.py, intent_assumption_rules.py, and intent_payload_rules.py) refuse an intent that has no assumptions list or no assumption_validation entry for an assumption, an assumption without an assumption_risk entry (likelihood, testability, score and response), a high-score untestable assumption without a mitigation, and a pr_question on a low or medium impact assumption; accept the same assumption when it has a mitigation and a pr_question, keep every other intent rule unchanged, and update e2e_harness.py, flow/stages/children.py, and the existing Stage 1, flow, and CLI test fixtures for assumption schema propagation. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Naming assumptions, how each is validated and what happens if it is false makes untested assumptions visible before any code is written.
acceptance_criteria: Target test: an intent without `assumptions` or without `assumption_validation` is refused at Stage 1.
Target test: an assumption without an `assumption_risk` entry is refused at Stage 1.
Target test: a high-score, untestable assumption without a mitigation is refused at Stage 1.
Target test: the same assumption with a mitigation and a `pr_question` is accepted at Stage 1.
Target test: an intent with an assumption that has no validation entry is refused at Stage 1.
Target test: a `pr_question` on a low or medium impact assumption is refused at Stage 1.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_stage1_requires_assumptions.py drives apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/intent_questions.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/intent_payload_rules.py with a real intent payload for each refusal and the accepted case.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.

All required assumption-validation updates and fixture propagation stay within the declared 18-file scope: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/intent_assumption_rules.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/intent_payload_rules.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/intent_questions.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/e2e_harness.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/children.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/cli/test_intent_check_cli.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/helpers.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_checkpoint.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_dispatch.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_intent_questions.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_pipeline.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_worktree_all_stages.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_intent_creator.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_intent_payload_rules.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_intent_scope_check.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_naming.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ref_names.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_stage1_requires_assumptions.py.
